verdict.rationale: Devin can start sessions from Slack/Teams conversations about feature requests and can reach issue trackers and Notion through MCP integrations, so it could plausibly turn feedback into tickets. No documentation shows it actually converting feedback submissions into structured tasks with proposed scope; the docs only cover consuming existing Linear/Jira tickets and implementing them. Missing for 10: a documented feedback-to-task conversion workflow, structured task/spec output with proposed scope, feedback-source intake beyond chat tagging, and any hands-on corroboration.
